title: Compilence multiplicative tier-lock check
asserted_expression: With positive T1 and T2 tier weights and similarities in (0,1], score = embedding_similarity * tier_weight can guarantee that every T1 candidate strictly outranks every T2 candidate.
asserted_exact_value: Exists positive finite tier weights that guarantee strict T1>T2 ranking for all positive similarities
does_not_establish: This checks only whether the public multiplicative score formula alone can enforce the separately stated strict tier-lock invariant over unrestricted positive similarities. It does not rule out additional lexicographic gating, similarity floors, candidate filtering, or zero-weight lower tiers that are not specified in the public formula.
source_basis: Public overview states that T1 authority is non-overridable and always outranks T2 guidance, while retrieval ranking is score = embedding_similarity * tier_weight.
